text: No deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis covered the entire asset boundary from 2021 to 2025 using high-resolution Earth observation data. While minor tree-cover loss patches under 0.5 ha were detected (0.4 ha in 2021), no deforestation events meeting the 0.5 ha threshold were identified. The asset had no forest cover in 2020 (JRC GFC2020 confirmed 0.0 ha), and prior losses (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020) fell outside the claim period. The data is reliable, with full spatial coverage (1.0 fraction) and annual monitoring up to 2025. Changes below detection limits or edge effects do not qualify as deforestation per the claim.
